items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Die Frist für die Einlegung des Einspruchs beträgt einen Monat.
items.computation: Letter dated Monday 27.04.2026, posted same day (no separate 'zur Post gegeben am' date given). Sender is a Finanzamt, so § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO applies: delivery deemed on the 4th day after posting, counted with the posting day as day 0. 27 Apr (day0) -> 28 Apr(1) -> 29 Apr(2) -> 30 Apr(3) -> 1 May 2026 (day4, Friday). 1 May is Tag der Arbeit, a nationwide public holiday, so per § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed delivery day shifts to the next day that is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday: Sat 2 May (skip), Sun 3 May (skip), Mon 4 May 2026 (valid) -> deemed delivery = 04.05.2026. Per § 355 Abs. 1 AO the one-month Einspruch period begins with the end of the delivery day (04.05.2026 not counted, § 108 Abs.1 AO / § 187 Abs.1 BGB) and ends one month later on the day with the same number: 04.06.2026 (Thursday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or holiday in NRW, so no further shift.
